scope: Current web media and squeeze JSON in app/public; desktop brand inputs and six voice inputs. Excludes source code, docs/screenshots and marketing media not served by the app. New in-scope files are included even before git staging.

statusMeaning.generated: Creation recipe/history identifies the output; only new avatars were byte-checked against their recipe. Not a legal clearance.
statusMeaning.source-authored: Source-native SVG drawing retained; no embedded supplied raster. Not a legal clearance.
statusMeaning.supplied-input: Known provided/offline input; generator or prompt history does not establish rights.
statusMeaning.reference-derived: Repository evidence explicitly identifies derivative reference-client content.
statusMeaning.unknown: Source lineage or permission basis not established.
statusMeaning.documented-permission: Reserved for a future exact-byte record linked to an actual retained permission; none assumed.

supplied-voice.summary: Six WAV source takes and six encoded MP3s: voice README identifies VoiceStudio profile/seed and describes Dan's cloned voice; sounds.mjs reads these takes. Generation metadata is not consent or a permission grant.
